subject: [RFC PATCH 06/18] mm: free the pages waiting for a grace period before OOM

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory management to free pages waiting for a grace period before triggering an Out-Of-Memory (OOM) killer. When reclaiming fails, it checks if freeing these pages would bring an eligible zone above its minimum watermark, and if so, frees them and retries the allocation. This approach is designed to reduce the likelihood of OOM kills by attempting to free memory from pages that are waiting for a grace period before resorting to more drastic measures. The patch also introduces a new metric, pgfree_rcu_drain, to track the number of times this optimization occurs.
